sections.adverse_reactions: The following clinically significant adverse reactions are discussed in more detail in other sections of the labeling: Hemorrhage [see Warnings and Precautions (5.1)] Infections [see Warnings and Precautions (5.2)] Cytopenias [see Warnings and Precautions (5.3)] Second Primary Malignancies [see Warnings and Precautions (5.4)] Cardiac Arrhythmias [see Warnings and Precautions (5.5)] Hepatotoxicity, including DILI [see Warnings and Precautions (5.6)]
